# Little Westies

> Little Westies (littlewesties.au) is an independent, source-linked directory of kids' and family activities in Melbourne's west, Victoria, Australia: playgrounds, nature, swimming, free library programs, school holiday programs, big days out, kids' classes (sport, dance, music, martial arts) and birthday party venues and hire. Every listing links to its public source.

Coverage: mainly the City of Melton and City of Brimbank, plus nearby western LGAs (Wyndham, Hobsons Bay, Maribyrnong, Moonee Valley/Keilor). Suburbs with listings: Aintree, Altona North, Brimbank, Brookfield, Burnside, Burnside Heights, Caroline Springs, Caroline Springs / Taylors Hill, Caroline Springs and Melton, City of Melton, Cobblebank, Cobblebank Stadium, Deanside, Deer Park, Deer Park Library, Diggers Rest, Eynesbury, Fraser Rise, Harkness, Hillside, Hoppers Crossing, Keilor, Keilor Downs, Keilor East, Keilor North, Keilor Park, Kurunjang, Laverton, Manor Lakes, Maribyrnong, Melton, Melton (Bridge Road Children's Community Centre), Melton (Kurunjang), Melton South, Melton West, Near Bacchus Marsh, Plumpton, Point Cook, Ravenhall, Ravenhall (Caroline Springs), Ravenhall / Hillside, Ravenhall, near Caroline Springs (Unit 5/94 Eucumbene Drive), Rockbank, School sites, Spotswood, St Albans, Strathtulloh, Sunshine, Sunshine West, Tarneit, Taylors Hill, Taylors Hill, Caroline Springs, Fraser Rise, Plumpton and more, Taylors Lakes, Thornhill Park, Toolern Vale, Truganina, Truganina (City of Melton), Truganina (trains at 29 Federation Blvd, Tarneit), Truganina, Point Cook, Werribee and more, Various venues, Weir Views, Werribee, West Sunshine.

Notes for agents: "not listed"/null means the provider did not publish that detail; do not infer it. Prices and times change, so point users to the source_url. Paid sponsor placements, when they exist, are labelled "Featured"/"Sponsored". Please cite "Little Westies (littlewesties.au)".

## Data

- [All listings, JSON](https://littlewesties.au/data/listings.json): parks, nature, swimming, free, holidays and days-out listings
- [Classes, JSON](https://littlewesties.au/data/classes.json): kids' classes with suburb, address, ages, days, price, website
- [Parties, JSON](https://littlewesties.au/data/parties.json): party venues and hire with area served, ages, price
- [This weekend's events, JSON](https://littlewesties.au/data/events.json): dated family events with venue, suburb, price, ages and source url (refreshed weekly)
- [Full text for LLMs](https://littlewesties.au/llms-full.txt): every listing in plain markdown
- [Sitemap](https://littlewesties.au/sitemap.xml)

- Last updated: 2026-10-24
